title: Chapter 256 Whose General Is This?
content:
Chapter 256 Whose General Is This?

"Kill..."

Utuk was quite decisive. After just one round of bombing, he decided to attack with all his troops.

Wang Shuo did not hesitate. The gangs that Wang Shuo had bought basically did not participate in the battle, so he had no burden at all to kill the enemies in front of him.

Zou Yuanjie immediately activated his skills and added buffs to the entire army.

The Golden Fire Cavalry was dispatched.

This time, Ayub's formation was finally thoroughly understood and could be used.

"The Long Snake Formation" can effectively pierce the enemy's formation. At the same time, there are formation changes such as the snake's tail swinging, which can greatly increase the radiation area of the cavalry and cause higher damage.

Eight hundred cavalry rushed into the army of 20,000 people. Wang Shuo was still a little worried whether he would be swallowed by the other side.

Soon, Wang Shuo had a smile on his face, and the uneasiness just now disappeared without a trace.

Ayub was invincible, and no one could stop him.

Countless gang members were knocked away and killed.

The Golden Fire Cavalry was in high spirits.

Ayub deliberately bypassed the central army where the guards were to avoid possible obstruction.

Although Wutu Ke was mentally prepared, he still found it difficult to accept this battle situation.

"Guards, go and intercept the enemy cavalry." He immediately said to his main force.

If the cavalry charges a few more times, the momentum of his troops will be gone.

Ayub turned his horse's head and charged again.

After the guards dispersed, it was difficult to completely avoid them this time.

But Ayub was not afraid.

Even when facing guards with a level nearly twice as high as his.

"Charge!"

Dust flew wherever the warhorse passed.

Ayub held the Qinglong sword, and the positive yang energy was poured into the blade, emitting a faint light.

"Bang"

With a loud bang, a guard was chopped and flew into the air.

A lightning bolt hit, and the guard lost one-fifth of his life.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank, and he was also a little surprised at this result.

He was just beaten away.

However, ordinary cavalrymen couldn't even knock the guards away.

There were even a few cavalrymen whose horses' legs were cut off and fell to the ground.

This comparison.

The lords watching the battle around couldn't help but gasp.

Many people said in Cao's tone: "Whose general is this?"

After checking the attributes of the guards, they naturally knew how difficult it was to cause damage to the guards.

When Ni Wu brought the guards to attack Wana Village, Wang Shuo relied on the bronze crossbow cart to leave more than a dozen guards.

If they fought alone, no one would be the opponent of the guards.

After all, the level difference was nearly 30 levels!

Wait until this round of charge is over.

Wutuk directly commanded the troops to rush into the enemy's infantry camp.

In this way, it can avoid the cavalry charge and fight a decisive battle with the opponent's main force.

Facing the aggressive Nanshanji army, Wang Shuo was not panicked.

Seeing the results of the battle just now, Wang Shuo was full of confidence. After taking over the command, Wang Shuo immediately made arrangements.

Gong Zheng led the shield soldiers to defend in the front row, the spear soldiers were in the back, and the sword guards protected the two wings.

The archers and crossbow battalion were in the middle, responsible for long-range attacks.

Soon the enemy entered the attack range.

The Hundred-Step Piercing Bow shot out arrows tied with Thunderbolts.

The entire enemy camp was suddenly ablaze.

The lethality of Thunderbolts, in the superposition state, was amazing. A large number of gang members fell to the ground in one round of shooting.

Those lords who wanted to take advantage were terrified when they saw this result.

If these hundreds of people wanted to compete with Wang Shuo's army.

They would probably be wiped out before they even met them.

As for the lords who sent troops to join the coalition, they were smiling. This time, the bet was right.
